jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
jobs.description:
Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle.
  
  
We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role.
  
  
Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions.
  
  
**What You Will Achieve**

* Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org's wider growth targets.
* Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act.
* Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks, transparent reporting and training into how the team works, so every campaign protects our trusted, non-partisan brand.
* Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society, civic tech and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers. Show up in person at the events, meetings and petition deliveries where those relationships are built, many of them in London and Westminster.
* Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in the UK on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations.
* Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership where people feel supported, trusted and able to do their best work, alongside a pace that matches the news cycle. Work closely with product, data and colleagues in other markets, and contribute to global campaigns and projects. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team, and lead or shape at least one cross-functional or global project that moves a wider business goal.
* Lead with AI, shape the product. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter. Work closely with Change.org’s product team as the voice of UK user groups. Test new tools and features early, feed back what works and what doesn’t, and turn launches into moments in the UK, showing petition starters how new features can help them win.

**What You Bring**

* A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks. You use performance data and testing to decide which stories to back, how to pitch them and when to change course.
* Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.
* An active network. You have active and trusted networks into UK politics (including key decision makers), civil society and civic tech, across the whole democratic political spectrum, including on the left, in the centre and on the right. You bring trusted relationships with UK journalists, editors and producers. You can use your contacts to place stories and move decision makers.
* Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You care about the people you manage and know how to build a team that’s positive, ambitious and pulls together under pressure. You’re happy rolling up your sleeves alongside them. At Senior Manager level, you have hired, managed performance and navigated team conflict, and you adapt your style to get the best from each person.
* Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are confident on camera and in front of senior stakeholders, with some spokesperson experience or the appetite to build it.
* AI-first, curious about civic tech. You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along. You’re excited by new tools and how people use them. You’re comfortable testing features, spotting what users need, and giving product teams clear, practical feedback.

**Target Experience**

* 5-8+ ye

jobs.description:
***About CDP:***

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

***About the Team:***

The Marketing & Communications function’s purpose is to Protect & Enhance CDP’s Brand, Connecting People to the Purpose through Storytelling, to Drive Sustainable Growth.

The Marketing team is responsible for building and stewarding CDP’s brand, developing and delivering campaigns that generate leads and drive audience action to meet organizational objectives, and maintaining high-performance engagement across digital channels.

***About this role:***

The CRM Marketing Manager will have the opportunity to shape and evolve our email marketing strategy, working with a wide range of colleagues to devise approaches that increase audience engagement and action.

You’ll play a key role as part of our new Marketing Performance and Enablement team, training colleagues, implementing plans and feeding meaningful data back into the process. Over time, you will support us to develop segmentation models and customer lifecycle plans.

***What you will do:***

You will be responsible for developing and delivering CRM marketing plans, devising and executing activity that drives value by increasing the number of organisations taking action (either by disclosing or signing up to one of our other programmes).

• Lead the creation, implementation and analysis of CRM marketing campaigns, with a particular focus on email, to CDP’s diverse range of audiences.

• Evaluate the performance of email marketing activity, deriving and disseminating insights clearly. Identify and implement opportunities to evolve our approach.

• Build an understanding of our audiences’ behaviour, working with colleagues across Marketing & Communications to build a holistic understanding of people’s interactions with us and the levers for increasing conversion and engagement.

• Build and maintain subject matter expertise on D365 Marketing and CDP’s use of it, continually seeking opportunities to improve and iterate our plans and set-up.

• Provide D365 Marketing and CRM Marketing advice to colleagues across the Marketing & Communications function and more broadly, translating marketing and business objectives into clear, measurable plans based on data-driven insights.

• Develop compelling email content based on best practice, identify opportunities to test, learn and improve.

• Manage the creation of automated customer journeys, monitoring and reporting on results.

• Train and support colleagues on the Dynamics 365 marketing functionality, as well as CDP’s processes and guidelines.

Actively contribute to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

• Ensuring you know what is expected of you, through regular 1:1’s, having clear objectives in place, and participating in open and honest performance and development conversations.

• Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference.

• Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to your position.

***We're looking for:***

• Demonstrable experience of driving value through CRM / customer lifecycle marketing for a complex, mission-driven organisation.

• Experience of superuser-level CRM access,with the ability to train and support others.

Experience of using marketing automation applications to run complex mailings, with continued improvement and learning integral to the approach.

• Excellent data analysis skills and the ability to distil actionable insight from wide-ranging data. Familiarity with a range of marketing analytics tools including Google Analytics, Hootsuite, Google Data Studios.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to support colleagues to create compelling email content.

• Experience of building brand engagement through email marketing plans.

• Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal relationships and communicate findings clearly.

• Experience of delivering B2B email marketing campaigns within a global organization that communicates in multiple languages.

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.

**Salary and benefits**
: The salary banding for this role is £39,525 - £49,407/year, 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, generous non-contributory pension provision, Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, training and development, flexible working opportunities and other benefits.

Final offer amount depends on multiple factors such as candidates experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data.

This is a permanent role based at CDP’s London office. Interested applicants must be eligible to work legally in the UK and live within a commutable distance of the London office and be comfortable with 2 days in the office per week.

You’ll also collaborate with a wide variety of fundraising teams across different specialisms, including legacies, individual giving, retail, information and support, and events, giving you broad exposure to the full breadth of the BHF’s work.

You’ll have the chance to deliver meaningful marketing that makes a tangible difference, while helping more people feel connected to the cause and motivated to support life changing research.

 We’re looking for a confident, customer-focused marketer with experience of developing and delivering successful retention, stewardship or customer marketing activity. You’ll be comfortable using insight, data and performance results to shape audience segmentation, customer journeys and campaign optimisation across channels such as email, SMS, direct mail and digital.

jobs.description:
**Want to build a marketing function from scratch, do every bit of it yourself, and make building maintenance the most interesting thing on someone's LinkedIn feed? Read on.**

**"Building maintenance marketing." We know. It doesn't exactly scream thrilling.**

**Then you meet the team abseiling down the Shard at dawn.**

Teams that look like Ghostbusters abseiling down London's tallest buildings. Centuries-old stone being carefully restored by hand. Cutting-edge tech meeting historical craftsmanship. The kind of work that makes tourists stop and stare.

We don't just maintain buildings, we're the guardians of London's skyline. From the Shard to St. Paul's, from Georgian townhouses to brutalist masterpieces, we keep the city's most iconic structures standing tall.

**Your mission?**
Build our marketing function from the ground up, and tell that story yourself.

There's no marketing team here. No agency on retainer. No PR firm. Just you, a blank page, and some of the best stories in the built environment.

You'll write the copy, build the Google Ads campaigns, pitch the journalists, run the LinkedIn, organise the events, and report on the numbers.

Strategy in the morning, keyword bids and press releases in the afternoon. It's busy, it's full on, and it's all yours.

**Before you read on, a quick honesty check:**

This role is not for you if your recent years have been spent leading a marketing team and directing agencies. We need someone who is still doing the work, and loves doing it. If you'd need to brief an agency to run Google Ads or get press coverage, this isn't the right fit.

This role is for you if you've come from any B2B sector where you've been the marketing person (or one of a very small team), and you've rolled your sleeves up across the whole mix.

**The Role at a Glance:**

Marketing Manager (Hands-On, Build From Scratch)

Remote Working

£50,000 - £70,000 DOE

Plus Benefits

**Company:**
Building Maintenance Without Limits

**Values:**
Integrity, Attention to Detail, Fun, Innovation, Adaptability

**Your Background:**
Hands-on, full-mix marketing in a B2B services business. Proven experience personally delivering Google Ads and PR, not managing others who do.

**The Opportunity**

**You'll build it all. Then you'll run it all.**

Strategy. Execution. Performance. There's no existing function to inherit, which means no legacy to untangle and no committee to get past. You'll set up the foundations, the plan, the channels, the tracking, the reporting, and then deliver every piece of it yourself.

And you'll prove its impact with data, because this role demands a commercial operator, not a vanity-metrics marketer.

**About Spectrum**

We're the team that abseils down London's tallest buildings to keep the city standing tall.

**What we do:**
Clean, restore, and maintain facades across London and the UK, from the Shard to Georgian townhouses, heritage landmarks to modern towers.

**What makes us different:**
We design, build, and patent our own technology. Our innovative rope access techniques and custom-built pole systems mean we deliver world-class results without scaffolding, saving time, money, and disruption.

**Who trusts us:**
Amazon, Canary Wharf Group, Knight Frank, Savills, NHS, Marriott, and hundreds of property managers and surveyors nationwide.

**The Role - What You'll Actually Be Doing (Yourself):**

**Setting Up the Function**

• Build the marketing function from scratch: strategy, plan, budget, tools, tracking and reporting

• Set up the systems and processes you'll need, from CRM campaigns to analytics

• Be the whole team, prioritising ruthlessly and delivering across every channel

**Google Ads & Digital (hands-on)**

• Build, launch, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns yourself: keyword research, ad copy, bidding, landing pages, conversion tracking

• Run LinkedIn as a growth engine, organic and paid, from content to campaign setup

• Manage email marketing end-to-end

• Monitor SEO and website performance like you own the P&L

**PR & Media (hands-on)**

• Write the press releases, pitch the stories and build the journalist relationships yourself

• Secure coverage in trade and property press, and beyond where the story warrants it

• Win speaking slots, awards entries and industry visibility

**Content & Brand**

• Write high-impact content: blogs, web copy, case studies, email campaigns, thought leadership

• Own the brand voice and make technical topics feel thrilling

• Plan and deliver a content calendar that tells a story worth following

**Events & Industry Presence**

• Organise and run webinars people actually want to attend

• Manage trade exhibitions and industry events, from booking to follow-up

• Build relationships with key trade partners

**Performance & Reporting**

• Track what matters. Report what works. Kill what doesn't.

• Manage the budget and demonstrate ROI with clarity

**About You:**

**You're not just creative. You're commercial. And you're a doer.**

You understand that marketing exists to drive growth, you love proving it with numbers, and you're happiest when you're building something rather than overseeing it.

**Essential Experience:**

• 5+ years in hands-on B2B marketing roles

• Personally built and managed Google Ads campaigns, not via an agency

• Personally delivered PR: writing releases, pitching media, securing coverage

• Experience as a solo marketer or in a very small team, covering the full marketing mix

• Strong content writing across digital channels

• Paid social (especially LinkedIn Ads) and email/CRM campaign management

• Performance reporting and ROI tracking

• Forward-thinking and tech-savvy, with a genuine enthusiasm for AI, automation and emerging technologies to streamline marketing, improve efficiency and drive results

• A modern, agile approach to marketing, embracing AI-powered tools and smarter ways of working rather than relying on traditional team structures

The role translates campaign strategy, messaging, and core content into ready-to-launch programs across channels and tactics.
  
  
The Global Campaign Manager works hands-on with marketing automation, content experience, and reporting platforms, partnering with portfolio & industry marketing team, marketing operations, digital execution, and campaign stakeholders to ensure smooth launches, accurate tracking, and performance reporting with continuous optimization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and orchestrate end-to-end global digital campaigns based on provided strategy and content.
* Configure and manage campaign programs across marketing automation and content platforms, including audience segmentation, campaign flows, testing and launch readiness checks, ensuring a smooth campaign journey.
* Coordinate with internal teams (portfolio & industry, content, design, digital execution, marketing ops) to ensure campaign readiness and execution.
* Partner with regional field marketing to coordinate campaign orchestration across global and regional tactics, ensuring aligned timing, consistent targeting, and a complementary channel mix, minimizing duplication and improving end-to-end lead progression.
* Monitor and analyze performance across tactics and channels to track engagement, conversion, and contribution.
* Optimize campaigns through practical, in-flight improvements and share insights and recommendations with key stakeholders.

**Essential Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in marketing demand generation roles, with a strong emphasis on digital campaign planning and execution.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex campaigns in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—consistently exploring innovative strategies.
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills and a passion for using insights to optimize performance.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage, influence, and manage diverse stakeholders across functions and regions.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in the industrial software or broader technology sector is highly desirable.
* Strong proficiency with marketing automation platforms (Marketo), CRM systems (Salesforce), content platforms (PathFactory) and marketing analytics tools.
* Deep understanding of digital campaign execution, including hands-on experience with paid search, paid social, content syndication, webinars, and related tactics, as well as their performance measurement and optimization.

**Marketing at AVEVA**
At AVEVA Marketing, you’ll be part of a diverse global group of creative, strategic and digitally savvy thinkers and builders. Through integrated reputation, demand, engagement and enablement programs, we are at the very heart of advancing AVEVA’s mission to spark industrial ingenuity and drive responsible use of the world’s resources.
  
  
Whether you’re crafting world-class events and experiences or defining the go-to-market strategy for a particular region, industry or solution, you’ll be driving the success of AVEVA and our remarkable community of sellers, partners and customers.
  
  
Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**UK Benefits include:**
Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
  
  
**What Sets Us Apart**
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
  
  
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.

**Truffle Social**

**Marketing & Communications Manager**

**This is our first full-time marketing hire.**

You’ll have your own budget, direct access to our leadership and the freedom to build Truffle’s marketing from the ground up. We want someone with a social brain, a writer’s ear and the nerve to walk up to an event organiser and say our founders should be on their next panel.

Marketing & Communications Manager

Farringdon | London

Full-Time | Permanent

Giselle, MD, with close working alongside Ellie our CEO

We believe in the infinite creativity of people. Our team is a carefully constructed blend of storytellers, design buffs, strategic thinkers, eccentric socialites, philosophical hermits, writers, talkers, doers, movers, shakers, and everything in between.

Part of your job is to bring that team to the surface: their ideas, opinions and personalities, turned into content people want to save, share and respond to.

**The Work You’ll Get to Shout About**

You won’t be short of stories.
**A few from our portfolio**
:

• Reiss: content and events that took the brand to New York Fashion Week

• London Fashion Week: a shareable social strategy for Julien MacDonald’s show

• Sport England, This Girl Can: real-movement storytelling with community-led casting

• NARS: content and social strategy for product launches across retailers and socials

• Hotel Chocolat: creator campaigns and CGI ads

• Eylure: a TikTok makeover built on trend-led content

• Mr Pretzels: new Instagram and TikTok channels built from scratch for Gen Z and Gen Alpha

**Why Now?**

Until now, our marketing has been done by brilliant freelancers, but now It’s time for one person to own all of it. Three things have come together this year, and you’re the fourth.

• We have a new brand strategy. We’ve just finished a full piece of brand work, so we know who we are and how we want to sound.

• We have a new business team. Our Partnerships & Commercial Growth Director is now building a team around her, starting with a new business executive. They’ll have the conversations, and you’ll help start them.

• We know who we want to work with. We want the big beauty, fashion and lifestyle groups, where one brand can lead to several more across the portfolio.

**The Opportunity**

You’ll get a healthy marketing budget, released quarterly, and the freedom to decide where it goes.

**You’ll be:**

• Building the plan. Turning the budget into a year of activity: the events, panels and awards worth our time, and what each will cost.

• Making the budget go further. Finding partners to co-host, sponsors to cover the bar and venues that want the footfall.

• Putting our founders on stage. Securing panels, podcasts and speaking slots, and helping Giselle and Ellie shape their point of view in articles and LinkedIn posts.

• Running our own events. Panel evenings, client roundtables and female leadership sessions that people want to be invited to.

• Being the social brain in the room. Spotting the TikTok at every event, capturing the content and getting it out that night, not next week.

• Turning great work into great stories. Refreshing our case studies, writing award entries with our Client Services Director and pitching articles that show how we think.

• Opening doors with the new business team. Researching the brands and groups we want, then creating content, outreach and invitations that get us noticed. You won’t be selling or cold calling. Your job is to start the conversations.

• Leading Truffle’s own social. Shaping the strategy for our channels with our social team, including our in-house TikTok specialist.

• Showing what worked. Tracking activity, results and next steps, with clear conclusions rather than numbers for the sake of it.

**About You**

You’ll have at least
**three years’ marketing experience**
, ideally within a
**creative, digital or social agency, or another B2B professional services**
**business**
.

**You’ll bring:**

• A social-first mindset and a real understanding of how the platforms work and change

• Confidence in a room full of people you don’t know yet, and the gutsiness to ask for what you want

• A resourceful, hustle-first approach: you’d rather negotiate, partner or leverage than simply spend

• Strong writing skills across case studies, award entries, emails and social, with spotless spelling and grammar

• Experience delivering events, targeted campaigns or ABM that contributed to new business opportunities

• Hands-on content creation skills in tools such as Canva and CapCut or Premiere Pro

• The ability to juggle several projects at once without needing close supervision

• Comfort with data and spreadsheets to track activity and spot patterns
